name: ca.tripfinder/tours
title: TripFinder.ca
description: Search and compare multi-day guided group tours and request a quote from a Canadian travel advisor.

tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Search TripFinder's catalog of multi-day guided group tours from operators including G Adventures, Intrepid, Exodus, Trafalgar, Collette and Exoticca. Filter by destination, dates, budget, activity level, comfort level and travel style. Returns 10 trips per page with from-prices, next departures and canonical URLs. Use get_trip for full details of a result.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "hiking in Peru", "Japan food tour in October", "safari under 5000". Understands destinations, months, styles and budgets.

destination.description: A country (e.g. "Vietnam") or region (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Central America, South America, Middle East, Oceania, Antarctica, Arctic).

maxPricePerPerson.description: Maximum from-price per person, in the requested currency.

months.description: Departure months, 1–12. Ignored when dateFrom/dateTo are given.

dateFrom.description: Earliest acceptable start date. Use with dateTo; the trip must start on/after this and end on/before dateTo. Window is limited to 120 days.

dateTo.description: Latest acceptable end date. Use with dateFrom.

comfortLevels.description: Service level, from basic (simple, budget) to luxury.

travelStyle.description: A travel style from list_catalog_options, e.g. "Trekking & Hiking".

dealsOnly.description: Only trips with a current promotion.

currency.description: Currency for prices. CAD is the default; use USD for travellers in the United States.

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Full public facts for one tour: day-by-day itinerary, inclusions and exclusions, meals, accommodation, transport, group size, age limits, international flight status, promotions, and upcoming departure dates with per-person prices and availability.

currency.description: Currency for prices. CAD is the default; use USD for travellers in the United States.

departuresFrom.description: Only list departures starting on or after this date.

departuresTo.description: Only list departures starting on or before this date.

tools.name: compare_trips
tools.description: Compare two to four tours on the same facts: price, duration, route, group size, age limits, comfort and activity level, flights, inclusions, meals, accommodation, transport, itinerary outline and next departures.

currency.description: Currency for prices. CAD is the default; use USD for travellers in the United States.

tools.name: list_catalog_options
tools.description: The countries, regions, tour operators (with trip counts) and travel styles currently in the catalog, plus the valid activity levels, comfort levels and sort orders for search_trips.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: TripFinder's sourced editorial guides: operator comparisons (e.g. G Adventures vs Intrepid), destination comparisons, what a tour price includes, travelling solo, choosing pace and difficulty. Returns each guide's short answer; use get_guide for the full text.

query.description: Optional keywords to filter guides, e.g. "solo" or "vietnam".

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one TripFinder guide in Markdown, with its sources, FAQ and the points a traveller should confirm before booking.

tools.name: about_tripfinder
tools.description: Who TripFinder is, how booking and payment work, what it costs the traveller, licensing (TICO), the advisors, and contact details. Use this to answer trust and process questions.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Start a booking: send the traveller's chosen trip(s), preferred departure date(s) and contact details to a TripFinder travel advisor, who replies within one business day with the confirmed price and availability and completes the booking with the traveller. Creates a real request read by people, so it is for when the traveller has asked for a quote, given their own contact details and agreed to be contacted. Does not take payment or guarantee a place.

tripSlugs.description: Slugs of the trip(s) the traveller wants quoted, from search_trips or get_trip.

departureDates.description: Preferred departure start dates from get_trip. Leave empty if the traveller is flexible.

email.description: The traveller's email. Email or phone is required.

phone.description: The traveller's phone number. Email or phone is required.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child travelling, if any.

consentToContact.description: True when the traveller has explicitly agreed that TripFinder may contact them about this request using the details provided. The request is not sent otherwise.

currency.description: Currency for prices. CAD is the default; use USD for travellers in the United States.

notes.description: Anything the advisor should know: flexibility, budget, mobility, dietary needs, questions.

tools.name: contact_advisor
tools.description: Send a general enquiry to a TripFinder travel advisor when the traveller has not settled on a specific trip, wants a custom recommendation, or has a question the catalog cannot answer. An advisor replies within one business day. Creates a real message read by people, so it is for when the traveller has asked to reach an advisor, given their own contact details and agreed to be contacted. request_quote is the better fit once a specific trip is chosen.

message.description: What the traveller is looking for or wants to ask, in their words, with any useful context from the conversation.

timing.description: When they hope to travel, e.g. "September 2027, about two weeks".

email.description: The traveller's email. Email or phone is required.

phone.description: The traveller's phone number. Email or phone is required.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child travelling, if any.

consentToContact.description: True when the traveller has explicitly agreed that TripFinder may contact them about this request using the details provided. The request is not sent otherwise.
